messages:
emma_cs: FYI — VireoThera needs a temporary APAC bump + CIDR allowlist for onboarding/demo tomorrow morning. Expecting automated test traffic + a short live demo spike.

liyah_support: Got it. Can you paste org id, IPs, exact window, and whether this needs dedicated capacity? Also any compliance caveats?

emma_cs: Org: vireo-348
IPs: 203.0.113.45/32, 198.51.100.12/32
Window: 2026-03-24T08:00Z -> 2026-03-31T08:00Z (UTC)
Target QPS: 60 steady, burst to 120 for ~10s max
Reason: onboarding demo + internal load tests. They've signed SSO; no raw PII in payloads but requests contain tokens. Security prelim OK pending KMS key sync.

raj_ops: Thanks — tagging @kai_engineer to prepare config. Confirming regional only (ap-southeast-1) and not changing EU/EU-edge settings?

kai_engineer: Confirmed. Will apply a regional rate-window + CIDR allowlist for vireo-348. If latency or errors creep we'll fallback.

kai_engineer: Proposed config snippet:
```yaml
customer_id: vireo-348
region: ap-southeast-1
ip_allowlist:
  - 203.0.113.45/32
  - 198.51.100.12/32
qps: 60
burst_qps: 120
window_start: '2026-03-24T08:00:00Z'
window_end: '2026-03-31T08:00:00Z'
enforce_only_on_region: true
```

emma_cs: Perfect. Can we set autorevoke and a 1-hour lookback alert to revert if error rate > 5%?

kai_engineer: Will do. Adding autorevoke at window_end + 30m and a regression rule: if 95th_p50_latency > 700ms or error_rate > 5% for 5m, auto-fallback to global standard tier and notify ops.

deploy-bot: Applying config to cluster inference-ap-se1. Change request id: cr-3114159265

deploy-bot: SUCCESS — CIDR entries and rate-window applied. Changeset: cs-5791. Autorevoke scheduled for 2026-03-31T08:30:00Z

audit-bot: Audit log recorded: change=cs-5791 user=kai_engineer org=vireo-348 region=ap-southeast-1

liyah_support: Noted. @emma_cs I'll schedule the enablement call at 07:30Z tomorrow and run the demo prompt set against a staging instance. Any custom prompts to include?

emma_cs: They want our summary+redaction example and the multi-turn recall demo. I'll upload the prompt pack and ping the channel.

raj_ops: After the demo, let's run a quick cost delta and suggest quantization + KV-cache warmup if they keep sustained traffic. Also flag renewal if they scale past dedicated thresholds.

emma_cs: Thanks all :thumbsup:
